description: Individual power readings taken outside a fully logged session. Each constrains the curve at one SOC only. Listed separately from sessions because a spot reading carries far less information than a timed session -- it says nothing about duration or energy.

readings.note: On a true 1000 V-class post, so the pack was not voltage-limited. This is the strongest single anchor in the set and it is the only thing holding up the bottom half of the curve.

readings.adapter: GM NACS DC adapter, 500 A / 1000 V
readings.note: DOES NOT CONSTRAIN THE NATIVE CURVE. A V3 is a 400 V-class cabinet, so the 800 V pack charged in split halves. This measures the station's voltage class, not the truck. The adapter was not the limit either -- GM's is 500 A / 1000 V and is never the bottleneck. Useful for validating lowVoltStationMaxKW; useless for curve shape.

coverage.note: Combined with the KATHLEEN session, measured coverage of this vehicle's curve is: one point at 13%, one window from 62% to 100%, and nothing at all between 13% and 62%. That gap is why the curve is labelled estimated.
